Self.Wiki: A group placement point: a group of enemies, placed from a RandomAppearParam row and tied to platoons, that gives a reward when all of them are defeated.

RandomAppearParamID.Wiki: RandomAppearParam row the group's enemies are placed from; 0 for none.

PlatoonEventNames.Wiki: PlatoonInfo events of the group (up to 4); a defeated character's platoon is checked against them.

PartNames.Wiki: References to enemies to defeat to receive the reward.

UnkPartNames.Wiki: Unknown parts (assets in retail, used by three regions); the game resolves them to their entities.

EstusFlaskRecoveryID.Wiki: The estus recovery values to use when the group is defeated.
